collections.title: Portraits
collections.intro: Studies of presence — the moment a face stops performing and simply is.

photos.title: Quiet Hour
photos.description: A pause between takes, caught before the sitter remembered the camera was there. The light does the introducing.

photos.title: Window Seat
photos.description: Portraiture as negotiation — half the frame given to the sitter, half to the room that shaped them.

photos.title: After the Rehearsal
photos.description: Fatigue photographs honestly. This was the frame after the one everyone asked for.

photos.title: Correspondence
photos.description: Two sitters, one letter between them, read only once. The second reading is for the print.

photos.title: Held Still
photos.description: A portrait made without direction — the stillness belongs entirely to the sitter.

collections.title: Landscape & Travel
collections.intro: Places encountered rather than visited — weather, geology, and the hour of the day as co-authors.

photos.title: Morning Light
photos.description: The fog burns off the plain in under ten minutes. This was minute seven.

photos.title: North Face
photos.description: Scale is the subject. The figure, barely visible at the ridgeline, is left for the viewer to find.

photos.title: Low Tide
photos.description: The sand holds the shape of the water for exactly as long as the tide allows.

photos.title: Salt Flats
photos.description: No horizon line to speak of — only a gradient from white to blue.

photos.title: Harbor, Dusk
photos.description: The last working hour of the fishing boats, photographed from the far jetty.

photos.title: Interior Weather
photos.description: Four seasons of weather moved through this valley in the span of one afternoon.

collections.title: Automotive
collections.intro: Machines regarded as sculpture — form, patina, and the discipline of restraint in every frame.

photos.title: Coachwork
photos.description: A body built by hand, photographed the same way — slowly, and without artificial light.

photos.title: Grid Position
photos.description: Fifteen minutes before the marshals opened the paddock. No crowd yet, no noise.

photos.title: Patina Study I
photos.description: Forty years of use, documented the way a conservator would document a canvas.

photos.title: Workshop Light
photos.description: The single window in the restoration bay decides the whole photograph.
